arStrings.szText: When {c_important}Deep Freeze{/c} ends, gain {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}({Shield:BARRIER_TOOLTIP}){/c} as a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Deep Freeze's{/c} initial hit makes surrounding enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} seconds. After it ends, your Non-{c_important}Ultimate{/c} Cooldowns are instantly reset and your {c_important}Frost{/c} Skills deal {c_number}[{SF_22}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} seconds.
